name: Dewford Town
lines:
Feast your eyes on this!
It’s a Silk Scarf. It’s the cutting edge of fashion!
Oh, I can see your eyes twinkling!
You appreciate my dazzling style!
What a delight you are!
Here, please. I want you to have it!

A Silk Scarf raises the power of
Normal-type moves. It’s a marvelous scarf
that will go with almost all Pokémon!

Wow, you bothered to cross the sea to
visit Dewford?
Are you here because you heard about Brawly?
He’s so cool...
Everyone idolizes him.
